"''I never heard of it.|Arvel Skeen and Cassian Andor|{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}}}} '''Sipo''' was an astronomical object in the [[Sipo system]] in the [[Kwymar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. During his turbulent childhood on the planet [[Ferrix]] after his adoption from his [[homeworld]] [[Kenari]],''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] spent three years in a youth center for juvenile criminals at Sipo, beginning at the age of thirteen. It was there that he learned about the [[prison]] tattoos, including [[Krayt Head]] and [[By The Hand]] tattoos. Andor's time at the Sipo center was just part of the great deal of time he spent in juvenile detention centers during his upbringing. In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|105}} the adult Andor—who was working as a [[mercenary]] in the [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team]] under the name Clem—told fellow rebel [[Arvel Skeen]] that he had spent time in the Sipo center, which gave him the experience needed to recognize Skeen's Krayt Head and By the Hand tattoos. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|The Axe Forgets}} {{1stm}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Sipo |ja=シポ |ka=სიპო |nl=Sipo |pl=Sipo}} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Kwymar sector locations]]
